title: Fluid control assembly and system

source_provenance.note: Request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted. Re-fetch from USPTO by publication number.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: a fluid source feeding a control assembly through a supply port
a normally closed supply valve that opens under controller command
a normally closed exhaust valve that opens under controller command
an outlet port coupled to a fluid-powered actuator
pressure sensing at or in communication with the outlet path
controller logic that adds fluid when measured pressure is below a selected threshold
controller logic that exhausts fluid when measured pressure is above a selected threshold
single- and dual-circuit arrangements for applying or relieving actuator force
applications to agricultural tool force control including downforce, row-cleaner, and trench-closing functions

scope_model.control_loop: measure outlet/actuator pressure -> compare to selected pressure band -> command supply or exhaust valve -> change actuator force/pressure -> measure again
device_patterns_relevant_to_independent_: bounded threshold-based control with explicit safe-state handling

independent_claim_themes: a fluid control assembly combining normally closed supply and exhaust valves, defined housing passages/ports, and a pressure-sensor port associated with an outlet
a fluid system using the control assembly, a controller, a pressure sensor, a fluid source, and an actuator that applies force to an agricultural tool
multi-path embodiments coordinating supply/exhaust operation for lift/down or pressure increase/decrease behavior
claim_scope_signals.a9_claim_set_warning: The A9 publication may contain corrections or republication differences. Re-fetch and compare the official A9 claims before any claim-element analysis.
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope is determined jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction from the controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and applicable law; this record is an engineering research abstraction only.

family_signals.territorial_status_rule: Do not infer global patent scope from one family member. Recheck each national/regional register before legal or commercial decisions.

design_divergence_defaults: treat threshold values and control policies as independently selected engineering parameters
separate safety supervision from normal pressure-control logic
provide an explicit de-energized or pressure-relief safe state based on the product hazard analysis
use independently designed valve topology, manifold geometry, sensor placement, and diagnostics
maintain provenance showing which public patent concepts informed each design decision
require claim-level review before commercializing a design that maps closely to a live family member

mandatory_safety_boundaries: pressure and energy limits derived from component ratings
independent hazard review for stored pneumatic or hydraulic energy
fault detection for sensor plausibility and stuck-valve conditions
audit log for configuration and control-policy changes
